_comment: 20 fixed regression utterances for smoke/001. Anchors: 'Daisy, Daisy' (canonical), pangrams, fricative-heavy phrases (covering /s/ /sh/ /f/ /th/ /z/ /v/ + aspiration + bursts so correctness/004 frication can reuse), and short prompts that load each manner-of-articulation class. Whisper-WER intelligibility gate is smoke/002 — these utterances are render-target inputs, NOT a quality oracle yet.

utterances.text: Daisy, Daisy, give me your answer do.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.
Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.
She sells seashells by the seashore.
Pushed sushi shops shut shop yesterday.
Fluffy feathers fall on fresh fields.
The three thieves thought through their theft.
Lazy bees buzz noisily in the breeze.
Vivid violets vie above velvet vines.
How high are the hopeful happy hounds?
Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.
Tutored Toby took two trains to town.
Kindly cookies came quick to the kitchen.
Big black bugs bleed blue blood.
Dazzling dolphins drift down deep dark waters.
Many mornings my mother makes muffins.
Nine nimble nuns nodded near the noon bell.
Yellow rabbits whirl rapidly along leafy lanes.
Sound choice, voice loud and clear, ride the wave.
